comparison.objective: Flex a 3D-printer build plate to release a printed part without kinking it, versus adjust and lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1949 requires symmetric controlled elastic bending and part capture; the candidate requires rigid tool seating, turning, and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1949 requires part release into a bin, plate restoration, curvature safety, stillness, and clearance; the candidate requires retained angle and functional cycles.
comparison.reason: Controlled elastic flexure and release are unrelated to threaded adjustment locking.
